theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Set α} (hsf : s.Finite) (hs : s.Nonempty) (htf : t.Finite) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s_max := Sup s
  let t_min := Inf t
  use t_min
  · intro x hx
    have h_le : x ≤ t_min := le_Inf hx
    have h_ne : x ≠ t_min := by contraposition; intro h; rw [h] at h_le; exact not_le h_le
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge h_le h_ne
  · intro y hy
    have h_ge : t_min ≤ y := Inf_le hy
    have h_ne : t_min ≠ y := by contraposition; intro h; rw [h] at h_ge; exact not_le h_ge
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge h_ge h_ne
